storeUrls.title: Storefront URLs
storeUrls.description: Shopify storefront homepages (custom domains or *.myshopify.com). Duplicates by domain are removed.

storeList.title: Storefront list (one per line)
storeList.description: Alternative to the list above: paste domains or URLs, one per line (commas and semicolons also work). Lines starting with # are ignored.

maxStores.title: Maximum stores
maxStores.description: Analyse at most this many storefronts. The run cost is bounded by this number.

fetchProducts.title: Read the public product feed
fetchProducts.description: Fetch /products.json (public on most Shopify stores) for last product update, price range, top vendors and product types. Exact product counts come from /meta.json regardless.

maxProductPages.title: Product feed pages
maxProductPages.description: Pages of 250 products to read per store. One page is enough for the last update date and price range; more pages only matter for stores with over 250 products when the exact count is not available from /meta.json.

extractEmails.title: Extract public business email
extractEmails.description: Collect role mailboxes (hello@, support@, wholesale@ ...) and mailboxes on the store's own domain that are published on the homepage. Personal mailboxes on freemail providers and named people on third-party domains are skipped.

onlyShopify.title: Only output Shopify stores
onlyShopify.description: Skip rows for sites that are reachable but not on Shopify. Unreachable sites are always recorded (not charged) so failures are visible.
